integrity: All mathematical statements refer to the explicit embedding and have an unrestricted elementary proof. The included verifier runs exact finite checks. scientific_limitations: The Euclidean metric is the untransformed orthonormal vertex-and-edge coordinate realization.
The source graph is connected, simple, and has an edge; isolated vertices are not encoded.
The equality of chromatic evaluations is proved at three colours only, not all positive integers.
Finite exact computations are corroborative and not a proof of arbitrary graph size.
Historical priority remains provisional; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Cosmological diameter graphs encode exactly the three-colourings of their source graphs
